purpose: Contrasting exact bounded native modeling lessons; prevent false self-teaching and confusion between cavity, shoulder and shroud.
source_scope: only original native geometry operators that passed structural GLB audits
feedback_source: authored labels; no pretrained/teacher-generated meshes or unapproved negative reviews used as positive geometry truth

learning_protocol.correction: sample previously hard and confusion-inducing cases, with explicit unique operation and numeric intensity
learning_protocol.blind: one evaluation after checkpoint choice; never sampled for optimization
learning_protocol.retention: replay original training labels and verify old heldout skills
